# Commands

<!-- Generated by make docs. Change the source it names and regenerate. -->

Generated from `herdsman spec cli`.

- [`afk`](afk.md): Print how long the user has been away: machine idle time or the newest message, whichever is newer.
- [`approval-gate`](approval-gate.md): Bind a relayed go before its effect: approval-gate consume ... | complete <request-id> <outcome>.
- [`checkpointer`](checkpointer.md): Checkpoint the orchestrator's memory and compact it: TARGET=<pane> checkpointer [--once|--probe] | checkpointer guard <name> <pane>.
- [`clean`](clean.md): Free what a task holds, after a verified snapshot.
- [`commit`](commit.md): Commit a worktree with a Conventional Commits message.
- [`config`](config.md): Read and change the configuration; install the shell integration.
- [`cost`](cost.md): Report measured tokens and cost per task, project or route.
- [`daemon`](daemon.md): The per-user message channel daemon: run|install|uninstall|start|stop|restart|status|route|setup|pair|credential.
- [`delete`](delete.md): Remove a route, once a verified snapshot makes that undoable.
- [`diff`](diff.md): Show a worktree's changes.
- [`doctor`](doctor.md): Check that this machine can run a route: herdr, gh, the binary, the inbox, the sandbox, the load.
- [`down`](down.md): Stop a task, then free what it holds.
- [`each`](each.md): Run a command in every worktree.
- [`eval`](eval.md): Report a suite's runs with intervals and an A/A control (experimental).
- [`export`](export.md): Copy the whole account to a new folder.
- [`go`](go.md): Enter a worktree.
- [`help`](help.md): Print the commands.
- [`hook`](hook.md): Show, approve or run a worktree hook.
- [`import`](import.md): Rebuild an account from an export.
- [`launch`](launch.md): Run one agent launch in a herdr-core terminal; herdr-core runs it, not a person.
- [`ls`](ls.md): List the repository's worktrees.
- [`mcp`](mcp.md): Serve the daemon's services as MCP tools over stdio.
- [`message`](message.md): The adjutant message channel: message status|wait|read|release|ack|send|hold|unhold, and register|courier|card-watch|resume-goal|authority|leak-gate.
- [`models`](models.md): Probe each installed harness: its version, models, efforts and default effort as it reports them.
- [`new`](new.md): Make a task's branch and worktree.
- [`notice`](notice.md): A managed agent's instructions on herdr-core: notice wait, notice read, notice ack.
- [`pause`](pause.md): Interrupt a route's agents and hold its channel; every pane stays open.
- [`plugin`](plugin.md): Manage plugins (experimental).
- [`project`](project.md): Work on a project's context repo: project context init|check|note, project log.
- [`prune`](prune.md): Free integrated worktrees past a minimum age.
- [`recommend`](recommend.md): The same as suggest.
- [`resource`](resource.md): Record a resource a task created: resource add.
- [`resume`](resume.md): Continue a paused route, or restart a stopped one from its record.
- [`review`](review.md): Prepare a reviewer: herdsman review start --worktree <path> --head <commit>.
- [`route`](route.md): Check a route folder (route check) or append a run-state line (route log).
- [`run-check`](run-check.md): Run one heavy check at a time on this machine, behind a load gate (--publish <hours>: the load reading).
- [`runtime`](runtime.md): Where agents run: runtime doctor, runtime ls, runtime default, runtime submit, runtime show.
- [`spec`](spec.md): Print the SDK contracts: spec cli|proto|descriptor.
- [`status`](status.md): Print a health snapshot of every agent in HERDSMAN_STATUS_SPECS and of the machine.
- [`stop`](stop.md): End a route's sessions and service panes; the work stays on disk.
- [`suggest`](suggest.md): Search the catalog of tips and tools.
- [`teardown`](teardown.md): Stop what a task runs, keeping what it holds.
- [`trace`](trace.md): Show or export one route's spans as OpenTelemetry.
- [`transcript-audit`](transcript-audit.md): Audit a Claude or Codex transcript for writes: transcript-audit claude|codex <transcript> <session-id> [root/ ...].
- [`undo`](undo.md): Restore a snapshot.
- [`up`](up.md): Start a route: workspace, private inbox, both coordinators, the pair and the first brief.
- [`update`](update.md): Install the latest signed release over this binary.
- [`version`](version.md): Print the version, commit and platform.
- [`wait`](wait.md): Wait for the next event of the loop (a report, a review, a blocked or stalled agent, a health flag), or TICK.
- [`watch`](watch.md): Watch implementers, the reviewer or pull requests: herdsman watch implementers|reviewer|prs.
- [`web`](web.md): Serve the web app and print its URL, with a one-run token, and a QR code.
